info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Replace Healthcare Appointments Reschedule-v3-spec
info.description: The Reschedule Healthcare Appointments API enables providers to efficiently modify existing appointment schedules for patients. This endpoint allows healthcare administrators to update specific appointment details, ensuring that patients are accommodated due to changes in availability or preferences. Typical consumers include healthcare management systems and administrative staff focused on optimizing patient care. The API streamlines operational processes related to appointment management, fostering better resource allocation and patient satisfaction.

put.description: This endpoint allows you to change the date and time of an existing appointment. You will need to provide the appointment ID and the new schedule details.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the necessary details for rescheduling an appointment. The provided data must include the new date and time of the appointment, along with any other relevant information required to process the rescheduling.
